cues: Ionise sodium: plus four ninety six.
Give the electron to chlorine: the electron affinity, minus three forty nine.
Letting them collapse into the crystal releases the lattice enthalpy, U.
The direct route, formation of sodium chloride, is minus four eleven.
text: Ionise sodium: plus four ninety six. Give the electron to chlorine: the electron affinity, minus three forty nine. Now we have gaseous ions. Letting them collapse into the crystal releases the lattice enthalpy, U. The direct route, formation of sodium chloride, is minus four eleven.
